entities.name: Lê Nghi Dân
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marquis Lệ Đức, born Lê Nghi Dân (黎宜民), was the fourth Emperor of the Lê dynasty of Đại Việt. His reign lasted eight months before he was deposed by a group of court officials. As he was deposed in a coup, he was not given a temple name.
